children: Rocket One announced it will acquire 100% of Tracer Drone Technologies to add a revenue-generating drone sales, services and training platform.
Entered definitive membership interest purchase agreement to acquire all issued and outstanding interests of Tracer.
Transaction will give Rocket One an operating drone platform serving public safety, enterprise and first-responder markets.
Acquisition creates a commercial channel for Swarm Stage AI and potential AI-enabled autonomous and counter‑UAS offerings.
Tracer is currently revenue-generating and offers hardware, software, training, maintenance, detection and managed services.
Closing subject to customary conditions; Tracer expected to operate as a wholly owned subsidiary upon closing.

title: Rocket One to acquire revenue-generating Tracer Drone Technologies, adds drone sales, services and AI channel
